text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Steadily building up her strength: Mejiro 
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For next year's Classics, she sets her 
sights as a stayer on the Kikuka Sho and 
its trial race, the Kobe Shimbun Hai—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She said she wanted to maintain this 
momentum without letting her guard down.
